faq.q: What is Paras Defence's latest net profit?
faq.a: Paras Defence & Space Technologies reported a consolidated net profit of ₹34.4 crore for Q4 FY26, a 74.3% increase year-on-year. For the full fiscal year FY26, the consolidated net profit was ₹89.46 crore.

faq.q: How much did Paras Defence's revenue grow in Q4 FY26?
faq.a: The company's revenue from operations grew by 58.3% year-on-year in Q4 FY26, reaching ₹171.3 crore.

faq.q: Did Paras Defence declare a dividend?
faq.a: Yes, the board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26, subject to shareholder approval.

faq.q: What was the EBITDA margin for Paras Defence in Q4 FY26?
faq.a: The EBITDA margin for Paras Defence in Q4 FY26 was 24.9%, a slight contraction from 26.1% in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year.

faq.q: What factors drive growth for defence companies like Paras Defence?
faq.a: Growth for defence companies is primarily driven by government defence spending, indigenisation policies, modernisation of armed forces, and geopolitical factors leading to increased demand for advanced defence technologies and equipment.

faq.q: Is investing in defence stocks considered risky?
faq.a: Like any sectoral investment, defence stocks carry specific risks, including dependence on government policies, budget allocations, geopolitical stability, and long project cycles. Diversification and thorough research are crucial.
